testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23075 admin creates a sales rep with all optional fields

scenario.summary: The admin creates a sales rep with the mandatory fields, External ID / Code, Phone Number, an image and a specific store, saves and closes, and every value is saved.
steps: On the Sales Rep listing click Add New.
Enter the mandatory fields: store (@storeA.name), username, email, first name, last name (made up by the test).
Enter External ID / Code and Phone Number (made up by the test).
Pick an image in the Image (DAM) picker.
Click Save and Close; re-open the sales rep's Manage page.
stateChanges: A new sales rep is created by the test in the UI; the test deletes it at the end (no collection owns it).
assertions: Store, username, email, first and last name, External ID / Code, Phone Number and the image are saved
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
FSD 'Create a Sales Rep': Login Information fields (External ID / Code, Phone Number, Image).
Image: an existing image picked in the DAM picker, the first one it shows (user decision 2026-11-25). PARTIALLY AUTOMATED: the case's 'Upload an Image' clause (a new file upload) is not covered.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
